page_title: ALA 0-2 OSA | Alaves v Osasuna 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+11' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+9' None of the Osasuna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+5' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Antonio Sivera is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
90+3' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez decides there was no infringement by Rafa Marin (Alaves) and the game can continue.
90+3' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
90+3' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Osasuna using VAR. Let's see what happens.
90+2' Rafa Marin (Alaves) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+2' Handball! A player from Alaves handled the ball. Osasuna are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.

90' 0 - 2 Juan Cruz passes to Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:2.
86' Luis Garcia Plaza (Alaves) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
85' Luis Garcia Plaza appears to have said too much and referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
85' Samu (Alaves) commits a foul and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez immediately signals a free kick.
83' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jon Karrikaburu (Alaves) replacing Ander Guevara.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luis Rioja trots off the pitch and is replaced by Xeber Alkain (Alaves).
82' Samu (Alaves) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
81' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
80' Luis Rioja (Alaves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
80' Bittor Alkiza is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Sergio Herrera suffers an injury and Aitor Fernandez (Osasuna) comes on.
78' The injury to Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
77' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Alaves fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
73' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
71' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez had an easy-decision to make.
70' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
68' Here is a change. Raul is going off and Bittor Alkiza gives the last tactical orders to Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Johan Mojica leaves the pitch to be replaced by Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
68' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
67' The game is interrupted now, Johan Mojica (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' Samu (Alaves) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
64' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Ander Guevara (Alaves) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
63' Substitution. Iker Munoz will be replaced by Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
63' Bittor Alkiza decides to make a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz will be replaced by Johan Mojica (Osasuna).
62' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) misses a great opportunity from inside the penalty area after blasting the ball towards goal and it goes wide of the left post.
59' Ander Guevara (Alaves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
55' The game has come to an end for Kike Garcia. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samu (Alaves).
55' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) replaces Nahuel Tenaglia.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) will replace Ianis Hagi.
55' It's like he was asking for a caution. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) receives a yellow card.
53' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Luis Rioja (Alaves) offside.
51' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
50' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
49' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) squanders a huge chance from point blank range. His volley is directed towards the right side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is alert and makes an amazing save!
47' Alex Sola (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
45+4' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' One of the players from Alaves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
43' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' Alex Sola (Alaves) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
38' Luis Rioja (Alaves) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.

36' 0 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna). He perfectly collected a pass from Ruben Pena, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the left post. The score is 0:1.
35' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) brought his opponent down. A free kick to Osasuna.
32' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
30' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
30' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
26' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) flashes a in volley from just outside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post. The goalkeeper can stay calm.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:1. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
21' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' Big chance! A simple pass from Ander Guevara left Ianis Hagi (Alaves) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
17' Alex Sola (Alaves) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
15' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the left post.
14' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will take a throw-in.
9' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
9' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves. Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
5' Ander Guevara (Alaves) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the left side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is alert and thwarts the effort.
5' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Alaves will take a free kick.
3' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Alaves will kick the game off.
